project_summary_alert: Project Summary (Lay Summary): Provide a brief overview in plain language for non-expert audiences.
study_title_placeholder: Enter the full title of your research study
lay_summary_placeholder: Explain your research in simple terms that anyone can understand. Avoid jargon and technical language.
lay_summary_helper: Write for a general audience without specialized knowledge
research_aims_placeholder: What does this research intend to achieve? What questions will it answer?
research_significance_placeholder: Why is this research important? What are the potential benefits to participants, science, or society?
research_significance_helper: Explain the value and impact of this research
investigator_cvs_alert: Investigator CVs Required: Evidence of research team qualifications and experience must be provided.
qualifications_placeholder: Briefly describe your relevant qualifications and research experience
qualifications_helper: Include degrees, certifications, and relevant experience
scientific_validity_alert: Scientific Validity: Demonstrate that your study design can answer the research question.
scientific_validity_placeholder: Explain how your research design ensures the study can answer the research question
research_procedures_placeholder: Provide a step-by-step account of what participants will be asked to do (e.g., interviews, surveys, clinical tests, observations)
research_procedures_helper: Be specific about all procedures involving participants
data_analysis_plan_placeholder: Describe how the collected information will be processed and interpreted
data_analysis_plan_helper: Include statistical methods or qualitative analysis approaches
research_timeline_placeholder: Provide a detailed timeline for your research activities
participants_alert: Important: Clearly define who can participate and justify inclusion of vulnerable groups.
study_population_placeholder: Describe the target population for your study
study_population_helper: Be specific about demographics and characteristics
sample_size_helper: Justify your sample size if possible
inclusion_criteria_placeholder: Clearly defined parameters for who CAN participate in this study
inclusion_criteria_helper: List all criteria that participants must meet
exclusion_criteria_placeholder: Clearly defined parameters for who CANNOT participate in this study
exclusion_criteria_helper: List all criteria that would exclude participants
recruitment_strategy_placeholder: How will participants be identified and approached? (e.g., flyers, social media, database screening, direct contact)
recruitment_strategy_helper: Describe all recruitment methods in detail
recruitment_materials_placeholder: Describe all flyers, emails, social media posts, or scripts that will be used to find participants
recruitment_materials_helper: Copies of actual materials must be attached
vulnerable_group_justification_placehold: Provide specific justification for including vulnerable populations in your study
vulnerable_group_justification_helper: Explain why this group must be included and how they will be protected
power_imbalance_placeholder: If you have a relationship with participants (e.g., teacher/student, employer/employee), explain how you will prevent coercion
power_imbalance_helper: Address any dependent relationships that might affect voluntary participation
third_party_permissions_placeholder: List any permissions needed from schools, hospitals, or other organizations
third_party_permissions_helper: Letters of support must be attached
informed_consent_alert: Informed Consent: Demonstrate that participants can make a truly voluntary and informed decision.
informed_consent_process_placeholder: Describe HOW and WHEN consent will be sought. Ensure participants have adequate time to decide.
informed_consent_process_helper: Include details about the consent procedure and timing
capacity_assessment_placeholder: How will you assess if the participant understands the information provided?
voluntary_participation_placeholder: Confirm that participation is completely voluntary and participants can withdraw at any time without penalty
voluntary_participation_helper: Explain how this will be communicated
withdrawal_process_placeholder: Describe the process for participants to withdraw from the study
withdrawal_process_helper: Include what happens to their data if they withdraw
participant_costs_placeholder: Will participants incur any costs (e.g., travel, parking, time off work)? State 'None' if no costs.
participant_costs_helper: Be transparent about any costs to participants
reimbursement_placeholder: Will participants be reimbursed for costs? Describe the reimbursement process.
incentives_placeholder: Will participants receive any incentives (e.g., gift cards, payment)? Describe amount and justification.
data_collection_methods_placeholder: Describe all methods of data collection (questionnaires, interviews, observations, etc.)
data_collection_methods_helper: Final versions of tools must be attached
anonymization_method_placeholder: How will data be de-identified? (e.g., pseudonyms, ID codes, removal of identifiers)
data_storage_location_placeholder: Where will data be kept? (e.g., encrypted drives, locked cabinets, secure servers)
data_storage_location_helper: Be specific about physical and digital storage
data_storage_security_placeholder: Describe security measures (encryption, password protection, access controls)
data_storage_security_helper: Explain how data will be protected from unauthorized access
data_disposal_protocol_placeholder: Describe protocols for the eventual destruction of sensitive records
confidentiality_measures_placeholder: Describe all measures to protect participant confidentiality and privacy
risk_benefit_alert: Risk-Benefit Analysis: Demonstrate that benefits outweigh risks and risks are minimized.
physical_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential physical risks to participants. State 'None' if no physical risks.
physical_risks_helper: Include discomfort, injury, or health impacts
psychological_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential psychological risks (stress, anxiety, emotional distress). State 'None' if no psychological risks.
psychological_risks_helper: Consider sensitive topics or traumatic experiences
social_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential social risks (stigma, discrimination, relationship impacts). State 'None' if no social risks.
legal_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential legal risks. State 'None' if no legal risks.
economic_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential economic risks (job loss, financial burden). State 'None' if no economic risks.
risk_mitigation_placeholder: Describe specific steps to minimize ALL identified risks (e.g., providing counselor contact info for sensitive topics, monitoring procedures, stopping criteria)
risk_mitigation_helper: Address each type of risk identified above
direct_benefits_placeholder: What direct benefits will participants receive? State 'None' if no direct benefits.
direct_benefits_helper: Be realistic - not all research provides direct benefits
indirect_benefits_placeholder: What are the potential benefits to science or society?
indirect_benefits_helper: Explain the broader impact of the research
risk_benefit_analysis_placeholder: Explain why the benefits outweigh the risks. Justify why this research should proceed despite the risks.
conflict_details_placeholder: Disclose any financial or personal interests that could influence the research
previous_approval_details_placeholder: Provide reference number, institution, and date of previous approval
documentation_alert: Mandatory Documentation: All checked items must be attached to your application.
check_documents: Check all documents that will be attached:
pis_desc: Explains the study in lay terms; includes contact details for PI and Ethics Committee
consent_form_desc: Formal document for participant signature (or verbal script/online version)
research_protocol_desc: Full scientific plan including references and detailed timeline
recruitment_materials_doc_desc: Copies of all flyers, emails, social media posts, or scripts
data_collection_tools_desc: Final versions of questionnaires, interview schedules, or observation checklists
letters_of_support_desc: Permission from third-party organizations (schools, hospitals) if applicable
investigator_cvs_desc: Evidence of research team qualifications and experience
additional_comments_placeholder: Any additional information or clarifications you would like to provide
consistency_check: Consistency Check: Ensure the number of participants, study title, and procedures match across ALL submitted documents.
review_alert: Please review all information carefully before submitting. You can save as draft and return later if needed.
before_submitting: Before submitting: Ensure all participant-facing documents use clear, everyday language without jargon. Verify consistency across all documents.
